name: evsoc_ford_hybrid_pt
description: Ford hybrids/PHEVs (model year 2021+, Ford architecture FNV2): listening to frame 0x24C Battery_Traction_4 with the traction battery SoC in 0.01 % (opendbc ford_lincoln_base_pt.dbc, MIT). Experimental: only works if this bus is present at the OBD socket; otherwise a tap is needed.

vehicles.model: Maverick / Escape / Kuga Hybrid and PHEV (experimental)
